info.description: P3 foundation contract. P4 endpoints are explicitly marked and are not a claim of a working business credential flow. Legacy P2 auth/wallet paths remain temporary compatibility aliases.

post.x-ownership: authenticated Keycloak provider only; never public
post.description: 4096-byte body maximum. HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + newline + exact path + newline + exact body, base64url encoded. Timestamp within 30 seconds. Operation/revision replay checks are durable; a stale callback cannot reopen a newer recovery. See P2-recovery-proof.md for the IdP fencing and acknowledgement boundary.

503.description: No acknowledgement; keep the gate closed

Operation.description: CANCELLED/EXPIRED is terminal TTL expiry; CANCELLED/TRANSMISSION_REJECTED is an explicit negative upstream transmission. Neither is sent again. RECONCILE_REQUIRED means an uncertain outcome; COMPLETED is a confirmed successful dispatch.

Credential.description: Wallet2 credential entry owned by the authenticated wallet; no wallet/key selector is accepted.

opaqueSession.description: Opaque application session; not an IdP JWT or ID token.
